Description: Password required for players to join. Empty means no password. Applied on the next Start. This is not your Steam password.
Letters, digits, _ and - only. Copy both .sav and matching .json when importing a campaign.
Minutes between automatic campaign saves (1–1440). Applied on the next Start.
Enable Steam advertising when Steam API is available to the running server. SteamCMD download login alone does not provide it. Off means direct connect only. Applied on the next Start.

I have read and accept the server's EULA and license in server/EULA.md (or EULA.txt) and server/LICENSE.txt. While enabled, the server receives DS_ACCEPT_EULA=true at Start and can accept the installed terms without a console prompt. Review the terms again after updates. Disabling this does not delete a prior acceptance. If no prior acceptance exists and this option is off, Start waits in Configuring at the Accept the EULA? [y/N] prompt. Read the terms, then enable this option or answer in the console.
